applications.title: My applications
applications.loginHint: Sign in with the account you created when applying.
applications.emptyHint: When you apply to a job, it shows up in this list.

landing.title: Job portal
landing.body: Each company has its own job board address. Use the link the company shared with you.

careers.emptyHint: Check back soon — new jobs show up here as soon as they are published.
careers.verifiedHint: This company answers candidates on time and the job has recent activity.
careers.notFoundHint: Check that the link is complete — it must include the company code.

job.notFoundHint: It may have been closed. Check the company's other openings.
job.closed: This job is no longer accepting applications.

apply.title: Application — {{job}}
apply.accountHint: The account links the application to you: it is how the recruiter reaches you and how you follow the process. If you applied here before, sign in with the same account.
apply.name: Full name
apply.screeningHint: Objective answers the company uses for screening. Answer honestly — verification comes later.
apply.resumeFileHint: PDF, DOC or DOCX, up to 5MB.
apply.resumeUploadFailed: Could not upload the resume. Try again or use the link.
apply.resumeUrlHint: A public link — Google Drive, LinkedIn, personal site.
apply.createFailed: Could not create the account. If you already have one, use "I have an account".
apply.applyFailed: Could not submit the application. Try again in a moment.
apply.missingFields: Fill in name, email and password to continue.
apply.doneBody: The company received your details and you are now in the process for {{job}}. Watch the inbox at {{email}} — that is where updates arrive.
apply.rejectedTitle: This one did not move forward
apply.rejectedBody: Based on your answers, the application does not meet a job requirement:
apply.rejectedHint: This applies to this job only — your data stays yours and other jobs remain open.
apply.alreadyTitle: You are already in this process
apply.alreadyBody: We found an existing application from you for this job. The company already has your details.
apply.otsJwsHint: Completed an AI interview on another platform? Paste the record (OTS document) here — the signature is verified instantly.
apply.otsAccepted: Interview record verified and attached to your application. ✓
apply.otsRejected: The record could not be verified (signature, e-mail binding or revocation). Your application was submitted normally, without it.
apply.sessionExpired: Your session expired — sign in again to submit the application.

profileImport.title: Bring my profile from Coploy
profileImport.hint: Imports your portable (OTS) profile from where it lives — experience, education and skills join your application without retyping.
profileImport.done: Profile imported — it shows up alongside your application. ✓
profileImport.emptyResult: The provider returned no profile data — nothing was changed. You can try again.
profileImport.startFailed: Could not start the import. Please try again.
profileImport.failedBody: The exchange with the origin provider failed — nothing was saved. Go back and try again; if it repeats, the provider may be down.
